decisions.reason: Grounds diagnosis in renderer-excerpt.ts: partial SGR prefixes (fg only) leave the empty half of a half-filled cell painted with the stale background persisted from the previous cell; names outline/sleep-Z/heart edge cells and symptom-log; fix is explicit default background (\x1b[49m) per half-filled cell.

Cites out.replace(/[ ]+$/,'') dropping trailing cells and the text pipeline not erasing beyond written text; two-part fix given: full-sprite-width padded rows plus explicit erase-to-EOL (\x1b[K) / canvas clear.

Reads frames-digest-report.txt: tail2 MISMATCH (23 cells, upper-right cluster shifted 1 col, hand-copied during conversion), existing per-excerpt regression for a different frame missed it; gate digests every frame against source art with CI assertion.

From ci-hang-evidence.txt: rescheduling setTimeout per animation tick keeps the loop alive; probe hosts mount without unmounting so cleanup never runs; interactive terminal unaffected (TTY/stdin keeps it alive); one-line fix timer.unref().

Checklist includes concrete items: explicit 39m/49m default SGR per half-filled cell, fixed-width rows plus EL erase, per-frame golden digests pinned in CI; rollout audit covers timer unref/clear and unmount behavior of every embedding host.
